compiled_state.title: Add audit_dd5_bundle.sh artifact bundler + epic-ticket attach
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-5: Audit artifact bundle (baseline, post-phase, mutation series, quarantine list, manifest hashes) committed to epic ticket on every phase advance

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd5_bundle.sh. Sources audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh. Verifies all 4 prior per-DD artifacts (.reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/dd{1,2,3}.json + quarantine-list path) exist + non-empty JSON. Computes SHA256 manifest hashes. Writes .reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/dd5.json with {phase, artifacts: [{name, path, sha256, bytes}], bundled_at, epic_id}. Commits artifact dir to tickets branch + posts one-line comment to epic ticket (--epic arg) with artifact dir path. Exits 6 if any prerequisite missing/empty.

## Test Approach
Given dd1/dd2/dd3 JSON + quarantine fixture; When audit_dd5_bundle.sh 2 --epic 4047 runs against stubbed ticket CLI; Then dd5.json lists all 4 artifacts with sha256, stub records one epic comment with directory path, exit 0. Given dd2.json missing; Then exit 6 + no comment posted.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] shellcheck + executable
- [ ] Full bundle success: manifest dd5.json with sha256 per artifact + exit 0
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd5_bundle.sh::test_bundle_success
- [ ] Missing prerequisite: exit 6, no comment posted
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd5_bundle.sh::test_missing_prereq_exits_6
- [ ] Success posts exactly one epic comment with artifact dir
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd5_bundle.sh::test_epic_comment_posted

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd5_bundle.sh — Create
- tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd5_bundle.sh — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Tickets-branch commit mechanism — DO NOT raw git commit to tickets orphan branch (no helper exists). Instead use the existing dso ticket CLI: (a) write artifacts to .reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/ on the WORKING TREE (not tickets branch), (b) call .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <epic-id> '...artifact-bundle...' with the bundle content (or file paths) as comment body — this attaches the artifact to the epic ticket on the tickets branch via the canonical ticket CLI. Concurrency: ticket CLI has its own internal lock; on lock-conflict retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (250ms, 500ms, 1s) before failing with exit 6 + 'tickets branch lock conflict — retry exhausted' diagnostic.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Strengthen dd-5 bundle contract — bundle MUST include pass/fail status from each of dd-1 through dd-4 PLUS overall_result derived via AND-logic across all four. dd5.json schema additions: {phase, artifacts: [...], bundled_at, epic_id, dd1_pass: bool, dd2_pass: bool, dd3_pass: bool, dd4_pass: bool, overall_result: bool} where overall_result = dd1_pass AND dd2_pass AND dd3_pass AND dd4_pass. Closes the gap where a partial bundle could satisfy dd-5 while upstream dimensions failed.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: task-5 RED tests use FIXTURE dd*.json files with locked schemas (from task-2 data contract section), NOT live outputs from task-1..4 execution. Schema fixtures defined in tests/unit/scripts/fixtures/dd_locked_schema_v1/dd{1,2,3,4}.json. Each fixture contains the canonical schema shape with synthetic pass+fail values. task-5 RED test set: (a) all-pass fixtures → dd5.json overall_result=true; (b) dd2_pass=false fixture → overall_result=false; (c) any per-DD field missing → exit non-zero with diagnostic. This makes task-5 RED tests independent of task-1..4 implementation timing and immune to upstream schema drift.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Live-evidence attach IS the SC-8 evidence. dd-5 attach step MUST run against REAL post-pass-8 state (not synthetic fixture); the resulting dd5.json artifact attached to epic 4047 via dso ticket CLI is the load-bearing SC-8 evidence. Add explicit AC for live-run mode: when --live flag passed, audit_dd5_bundle.sh reads dd*.json from .reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/ which MUST have been written by live audit runs (not fixtures); fail-closed exit 8 if dd*.json files are detected as fixture-generated (e.g., test-only file marker). Story-closure verifier checks: epic 4047 has a comment whose body references a dd5.json artifact with overall_result=true AND --live mode marker. Rationale: validation-class closure cannot pass on synthetic fixtures (cross_task_interference).
comments.author: Test
